name: world-war-z-community-app
description: Native wrapper foundation for the World War Z dashboard and PWA.

scripts.native:sync: npm run native:prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.native:add:android: npm run native:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.native:add:ios: npm run native:prepare && npx cap add ios
scripts.native:android: npm run native:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.native:ios: npm run native:sync && npx cap open ios
